# <span id="aanchor224"></span> Create Companies

Companies can be created manually in the Company Manager or in bulk using FcLoader.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new company:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Company Manager** in the **Contacts** group.
3.  Click **New**.
4.  Enter a company name and number.
5.  For liquid tickets, select a transportation, truck, or rail option if applicable.
6.  Click **Save**.
